newsitem.title: FRANCE: British trucker held after French drug seizure.
newsitem.headline: British trucker held after French drug seizure.

text.p: A 53-year-old British lorry driver was detained at the French entrance to the Channel Tunnel after 50,000 ecstasy pills and 378 kg (830 lbs) of crack cocaine were found in his vehicle, French customs said on Wednesday.
The driver, who was identified only as coming from London, had been held on suspicion of drugs trafficking since November 7, a customs statement said.
Customs agents believed the illegal drugs were loaded in the Netherlands and the delivery point was to be somewhere in the southeastern English county of Kent, the statement said.
The seizure of crack, resulting from the use of a new scanning device, was the largest to date in metropolitan France, the statement added.
